correctness.rationale: The diagonal of vv^T equals v over F2, so rank-one map injective; b_ij=(1+chi_i+chi_j-chi_ij)/2 makes invertible triangular transformation from the intrinsic Walsh band. Full-cube Walsh orthonormality and removal of zero yields W=(QI-11^T)/(Q-1), giving positivity and determinant for 2^d>1+d+binom(d,2). Direct moments produce the complete-graph unsigned vertex-edge incidence block G0; BB^T=(d-2)I+J yields orthogonal 3+(2(d-1))+(m-d) decomposition. The standard 2x2 block and edge kernel give all eigenvalues. A Rayleigh quotient for vector (-sqrt(m)/2,-sqrt((d-1)/2),1), plus strict diagonal/trace comparison for the top, locates both extrema in symmetric H_d for every d>=3. H0 has eigenvalue 1 and quadratic pair product 1/4, its rank-one puncture correction is O(d^2/2^d), so largest ~d^2/8, smallest ~2/d^2, ratio ~d^4/16. Independently built exact Gram for d=3..8 and tested sector eigenvalues; exact determinant checked for d=3..5. Those small dimensions do not prove the infinite limit.
residual_risks: Finite diagnostic checks corroborate but do not replace analytical all-parameter proof.
